notes.title: Input issues linked to 3DConnexion KMJ emulator driver
notes.content:
A user found a fix related to input not being recognized properly in G:LAM. For some users at least, it might be tied to "3DConnexion KMJ emulator driver". If you open the game and the input is all twitchy and keeps auto-selecting options, this might be your issue.

Conveniently, there is a fix. Read here: [url=https://www.revit.news/2016/10/how-to-disable-the-3dconnexion-kmj-emulator-driver-for-game-controllers/]How to disable 3DConnexion KMJ emulator[/url]

This should now work properly! Please note that this fix will also work for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3245050/Hockey_Super_Squad/]Hockey Super Squad[/url].

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: G:L&M v1.0.4.2 PC PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Nothing like a good update! There’s a lot to unpack here, so let’s cut to the chase:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fort rewards not correctly saving upon completion
[*] Morris dash ability not working properly on certain surfaces

notes.title: Firestoke Publisher Sale - LIVE NOW!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060790/Hauntii/][b]Hauntii[/b][/url]

Experience a light-hearted roguelite platformer where you take control of an oddball couple on a holiday from hell. Work together as you navigate randomly generated temples, dodging traps, slaying enemies, and crafting weapons in an attempt to escape before the temple floods.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/791200/Planet_Cube_Edge/][b]Planet Cube: Edge[/b][/url]
Get ready for high-speed adventuring set in a hand-crafted pixel art world, filled with precision platforming and thrills. Planet Cube is being invaded, and it's up to you to run, gun, jump, and dash your way through an underwater science complex, collecting firepower to turn the tables on a mysterious aggressor.

notes.title: Goons: Legends & Mayhem v1.0.2 OUT NOW
notes.content:
[b]G:L&M v1.0.2.7 PC PATCH NOTES[/b]

Hey everyone, we're happy to go forward with some bug fixing and new features additions like the bots/goaltenders difficulties. Hard mode soon? 👀

Stay updated to learn more about our roadmap for new features, for the Mayhem is only beginning!

[u]Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*]Local/Remote Play P2 controls P1 in online matches once a goal is scored
[*]Shorter Power slapshot/pass range in matches
[*]Mayhem stuck when spawned right in front of the Spindle Lady goaltender
[*]Fishmonger and Spindle goaltenders holding pucks when using abilities
[*]Playable bots feature is broken once in Overtime mode
[*]Faceoff always performed by the lowest number Player in a team (P1, P4, etc.)
[*]L-stick/L3 button performs Emote instead of X-Square button only
[*]Increased contrast on unselected menu options in Pause menu
[/list]

[u]Features:[/u]
[list]
[*]New “Bots difficulty” option in match creation
[*]New “Wave” features showing how many enemies are left in fort minigames, as well as their placement in the area
[*]Match faceoff reduce to a single Rock Paper Scissors minigame
[/list]

notes.title: It's time! The penguins of Zambonia welcome you!
notes.content:
Hey there, hockey fans! The wait is finally over - Goons: Legends & Mayhem is officially here and ready to rock your world! Or.. freeze it?

We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a game that's all about epic battles, wacky and outrageous characters, and non-stop fun. Whether you're a seasoned gamer, a hockey enthusiast or just looking for some chaotic action, Goons has something for everyone!

Get ready to team up with friends, unleash your inner hero, and dive headfirst into a world of mayhem. From arcade hockey showdowns to epic brawls in fantastical realms, the adventure never ends in Goons.

Don't just take our word for it though - grab your ice skates and your controllers, round up your crew, and experience the madness for yourself! Whether you're playing solo or joining forces with friends, there's never been a better time to jump into the action.

So what are you waiting for? Join us in the mayhem and let's make some gaming memories together! See you out on the ice rinks!

Oh and of course, thank you to everyone for the love on our game. You guys, this community, it's always the biggest and the best part. We couldn't have made it here without your support!

Much love,
Firestoke and RageCure Games

notes.title: Goons - January 2024 Showcase (Quebec Games Celebration)
notes.content:
We love events and so we're pumped to have been invited to the Quebec Games Celebration taking place from 29th Jan - 2nd Feb! We even filmed a new dev play-through which you can check out on the Steam page! 

Quebec is one of the top five largest video game development hubs in the world and is currently home to more than 290 studios across the province. Brought to you in collaboration with La Guilde du jeu vidéo du Québec, the event celebrates our thriving industry and gives players a look at what the local community has to offer.

We have lots of exciting Goons news coming soon so make sure to keep an eye out :)
